name: Bensheimer Weihnachtsflohmarkt
description: the town's indoor Christmas flea market, second-hand only
note: all stands taken; no new goods
details:
The Christmas flea market of the town of Bensheim fills the Weststadthalle, the biggest event hall of the Bergstraße district. The city says all stands were taken within a short time again, so there is a big mix of junk, collectibles and nostalgia items; selling new goods is not allowed.

Saturday 8-14, free entry. The TSV Auerbach football section serves coffee, cake, rolls and sausages in the Bürgerraum.

Address from an event directory (regioactive.de), not from Maps.
